title: Honey Garlic Butter Chicken Mac n Cheese
description: Absolutely one of the best combos, so indulgent, bursting with flavour and packed with 60g of protein!

items: 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (omit for milder flavour)
1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!)
100g (3.5oz) Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (or any low fat cheese)
220g (8oz) Uncooked Macaroni Pasta (or pasta of choice)

steps: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes. In a bowl, season with salt, pepper, chili flakes, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated, then set aside.
Bring a pot of water to a boil and add the macaroni. Cook for 8 minutes until the pasta is al dente, then drain immediately and set aside, as the pasta will finish cooking in the sauce.
Heat a large pan over medium heat and melt 10g of butter. Add half of the chicken cubes in a single layer and cook for 5 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy

Now lower the heat, add an extra 10g of butter, minced garlic, a drizzle of honey, and freshly chopped parsley. Toss the chicken until it's well coated in these vibrant flavours. Remove the chicken and set aside. Repeat for the second batch.

In the same pan on low heat with the flavorful butter left behind, add more minced garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Stir in milk and cream cheese, then season with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and a pinch of nutmeg. Mix until the sauce is smooth.
Stir in grated cheddar cheese until it melts into the sauce and thickens slightly. Add the drained macaroni and gently toss to ensure everything is evenly coated.
Portion the mac n cheese with the juicy honey garlic chicken into 4 servings and ENJOY!
notes: Preheat a pan over medium heat, melt butter, then add chicken. Avoid overcrowding for even cooking.
Sear for 4–5 minutes on one side until golden brown, then flip and cook for another 3 minutes.
Lower heat completely then add butter, garlic, and honey. Stir until chicken is well coated and sticky.

title: Crispy Salt N Pepper Chicken & Chips
description: Combining 2 very popular takeout meals! This tastes absolutely delicious, is low in calories, filling and easy to make for the week ahead!

items: 1 Tsp each Salt, Pepper, Garlic Powder, Paprika
1 Tsp each Salt, Pepper, Garlic Powder, Paprika, Chilli Flakes

steps: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes. In a bowl, marinate the cubes with soy sauce, black pepper, garlic powder, and cornflour. Mix thoroughly until the color changes; if needed, add more soy sauce and spices.

Slice your washed potatoes into chips. Arrange them on a lined baking tray (use baking paper) and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and olive oil until evenly coated. Oven bake at 210°C/420°F for 25 minutes or air fry for 15 minutes.

While the chips are cooking, heat a pan over medium heat and add olive oil. Cook the marinated chicken for 4–5 minutes on each side until a golden-brown, crispy crust forms. If needed, cook a few extra minutes. Remove the chicken and set aside, cooking in batches if necessary.

In the same pan, over medium heat, add the chopped onions and bell peppers. Sauté for 2–4 minutes until softened. Then add extra salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, chilli flakes, a drizzle of honey, the cooked chips, and chopped green onion.
Mix everything together until well incorporated and let cook for an additional 1–2 minutes. Finally, divide into 4 equal servings and ENJOY!
notes: Mix chicken thoroughly until dark and rich in color. Add more spices or soy sauce if needed.
Avoid overcrowding the pan to ensure a crispy crust on the chicken.
Bake fries for 25 minutes or air fry for 15 minutes at 210°C (420°F).
Reheat fries in a pan or air fryer to restore crispiness.

title: Creamy Chipotle Steak & Potatoes
description: One of the best meal preps you can make! So easy and simple - Juicy seasoned steak paired with creamy chipotle potatoes

items: 800g (28oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef, 1 inch cubed

steps: Slice the steaks into 1 inch cubes. Season with salt, garlic powder, parsley, cumin, smoked paprika, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until each piece is well coated.
Wash the potatoes and cut into small cubes. Place them in a bowl and mix with Italian herbs, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and olive oil until evenly coated.
Arrange the seasoned potatoes on a lined baking tray (use baking paper). Oven bake or air fry at 200°C/400°F for 20–22 minutes until golden and crispy.
While the potatoes are cooking, heat a pan over medium-high heat and add 5g of butter.Cook half of the steak bites for about 2-3 minutes per side until a beautiful brown crust forms.

Once cooked, lower the heat completely, then add 5g extra butter and freshly chopped parsley to the pan. Toss the steak bites until each piece is well coated, then set aside. Repeat for the second batch.

In the same pan over medium-low heat, add chopped garlic and red onion. Sauté for 5 minutes until softened, then stir in Italian herbs and chipotle paste for 2-3 minutes. Next, add evaporated milk, cream cheese, and grated parmesan; stir until the sauce is smooth and creamy.
Drop the crispy potatoes and fold into the sauce, ensuring every piece is well coated. Divide the dish evenly with the steak bites, and ENJOY!
notes: Marinate steak bites for at least 10–15 minutes for deeper flavor.
Cook on medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes per side in butter until nicely charred. Avoid overcrowding for a proper crust.
Oven-bake or air-fry potatoes for 20–22 minutes at 200°C (400°F).
No need to cook the sauce, just mix on low heat until smooth, then add the cooked potatoes.

title: Lemon Pepper Chicken Rice Bowls
description: The flavours in this are absolutely incredible, so simple and perfect to meal prep for the week ahead!

items: 800g (28oz) Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cubed

steps: Trim any excess fat from the chicken thighs and cut them into cubes. Season with salt, black pepper, oregano, chilli flakes, garlic powder, paprika, lemon zest & juice, and olive oil.
Mix the chicken thoroughly until the color deepens, then set aside to marinate. Meanwhile, prepare your white basmati rice for later use.

In a bowl, combine yogurt, mayo, Dijon mustard, garlic & onion powder, salt, pepper, lemon juice, and parsley. Mix until smooth, then fold in the chopped tomato and cucumber. Give it one final mix till creamy and well coated.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt butter. Sear the marinated chicken for 6–7 minutes until golden brown. Lower the heat, then drizzle with lemon juice and honey. Toss until the chicken is well glazed, then set aside.
In the same pan on low heat, add chopped garlic and onion. Sauté for 5 minutes until fragrant, then stir in turmeric, paprika, salt, and oregano. Cook for an additional 2 minutes.

Add the cooked basmati rice and fresh parsley to the pan. Mix well until the rice turns a vibrant golden yellow. Drizzle with a little more lemon juice, toss, and serve alongside the lemon pepper chicken and ranch salad then ENJOY!
notes: Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes; trim excess fat from the thighs for a leaner finish.
For a higher-protein, lower-fat option, use chicken breast instead.
Cook on medium-high heat for 4 minutes per side until a golden crust forms.
Prepare the rice and ranch salad in advance, store the salad separately to keep it fresh when reheating.
Reheat chicken and rice in a pan over low heat for 5 minutes or microwave, then serve the ranch salad at room temperature.

title: Cheesy Beef Taco Potato Bowls
description: This is without a doubt THE BEST recipe i've made this year so far! The flavours are INCREDIBLE!

items: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Cumin, Paprika, Chilli Powder, Oregano
40g (1.4oz) Shredded Mozzarella (or any low fat cheese / 10g per serving)
20g (0.7oz) Grass Fed Butter (or butter of choice)
3/4 Tsp each Salt, Paprika, Garlic Powder
1/2 Tsp each Salt, Pepper, Garlic Powder, Cumin, Paprika

steps: Slice the potatoes into small cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Season with 1 serving of taco spice mix and a drizzle of olive oil. Toss until evenly coated, then spread them on a lined baking sheet (use baking paper). Bake or air fry at 200°C/400°F for 20–22 minutes until golden and crispy.
For the chipotle spicy sauce, blend yogurt, mayo, chipotle paste, buffalo hot sauce, honey, salt, paprika, and garlic powder until smooth and creamy. Store in a bottle to use throughout the week.

For the pico de gallo, combine chopped tomatoes, red onion, red and green bell peppers, and coriander in a large bowl. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, cumin, paprika, and lime juice. Mix well, then store in a separate container for the week.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt the butter. Add the ground beef and cook for 8 minutes, breaking it up with a spatula until fully browned. Stir in tomato paste and 1.5 servings of taco spice mix, then cook for another 4 minutes until juicy and golden.
Top the taco beef with shredded mozzarella and serve with crispy potatoes, pico de gallo, and a generous drizzle of chipotle spicy sauce. Enjoy!
notes: Season potatoes thoroughly and mix well to ensure every piece is evenly coated.
Prepare the sauce in advance and store in a bottle for future meals.
Keep the pico/salsa in a separate container and serve fresh when ready to eat.
If the taco beef gets too dry, add a dash of water for extra moisture.
Reheat only the potatoes and beef since the pico is stored separately.

title: Grilled Chicken Alfredo Pasta
description: One of the most indulgent meal preps i've made! Chicken is cooked to perfection, paired with a rich creamy Alfredo Pasta. So simple and easy with great macros

items: 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (omit for less heat)
1 Tsp each Salt, Italian Herbs, Parsley, Paprika
1/2 Tsp Chilli Flakes (omit for milder flavour)
Optional Pasta Water if the sauce is too thick

steps: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes. In a bowl, season with salt, Italian herbs, parsley, chilli flakes, garlic powder, paprika, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until evenly coated, then set aside.
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook for 7-8 minutes until al dente. Before draining, reserve 1/4 cup of pasta water, then set the pasta aside.
Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and melt 5g of butter. Add half of the seasoned chicken in a single layer and sear for 3–4 minutes per side, allowing a rich golden crust to form.
Reduce the heat to low, then add 10g extra butter and gently stir the chicken until glossy and well coated. Remove from the pan and repeat for the second batch.

In the same pan on low heat add chopped garlic and onion. Sauté for 5 minutes until soft and aromatic, then mix in additional seasoning (salt, Italian herbs, parsley, chilli flakes, paprika) to enhance the depth of flavor.

Pour in tomato passata and let it simmer on low heat for 5 minutes, allowing the sauce to thicken and intensify in flavor. Stir in evaporated milk, cream cheese, and grated parmesan, mixing until smooth and velvety.
Gently fold in the cooked pasta, ensuring it's well coated in the creamy, flavorful sauce. Serve with the succulent grilled chicken, divide into 4 portions, and enjoy this rich, high-protein meal!
notes: Cook garlic and onion for 5–6 minutes until soft, then mix in the spices for 1 minute before adding tomato sauce.
Let the sauce simmer on low heat for at least 5 minutes until it bubbles and slightly separates.
Add milk and cream cheese on low heat, stirring continuously until smooth and thick.
Reheat chicken and pasta in a pan on low heat, covered, for 5 minutes. Add a splash of milk if the sauce is too thick.

title: Garlic Butter Steak Bites & Cajun Mac n Cheese
description: Another incredible combo! Juicy & flavourful Steak Bites paired with creamy well seasoned Mac n Cheese. So simple and easy to make, great for meal prep!

items: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Paprika, Chilli Powder or Cayenne Pepper, Thyme, Oregano
800g (28oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef, 1 inch cubed
200g (7oz) Uncooked Macaroni Pasta (or pasta of choice)

steps: Cut the steaks into 1 inch cubes. In a bowl, season the cubes with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, parsley, chilli powder and olive oil. Mix well, then let the meat marinate for 10 minutes.

Bring a pot of water to a boil and add the macaroni pasta. Cook for 8 minutes until al dente. While the pasta is boiling, begin cooking the steak bites. Once the pasta is ready, drain and set it aside.
Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and melt 10g of butter. Sear half of the steak bites for about 3 minutes on each side until a golden brown crust forms.

Lower the heat to low, add extra 10g of butter, minced garlic, and chopped parsley to the pan. Toss the steak bites in this flavorful butter until each piece is well coated. Remove the beef from the pan and keep warm. Repeat this for the second batch.
Using the same pan on low heat, add the milk, cream cheese, cheddar, mozzarella, and the Cajun spice mix. Stir continuously until the sauce becomes smooth and indulgently creamy.
Now add the cooked pasta in the sauce, give it a good mix till combined. Garnish with parsley then serve with the delicious steak bites and your high protein meals are ready for the week!
notes: Sear steak bites over medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Lower heat, add butter, garlic, and parsley. Stir for 1 minute until well coated, then set aside.
On low heat, stir sauce until smooth. Once cheese melts, mix in macaroni, adding pasta water or milk if needed.

title: Honey Chipotle Chicken
description: There's no reason to be meal prepping plain chicken & rice! This is an incredibly delicious meal prep and so simple to make

items: 70g Chipotle Paste or Chipotle Peppers in Adobo
280g Raw Basmati Rice (Cook this prior to making this)
I like to pair this with a nice side salsa consisting of chopped tomatoes, red onion, bell peppers, cucumber, salt, pepper and pickle juice

steps: Place the boneless, skinless chicken thighs in a bowl and season with salt, oregano, garlic powder, smoked paprika, cumin, chipotle paste, honey, and fresh lime juice. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is fully coated and deeply coloured, then set aside to marinate.
While the chicken marinates, heat a pan over medium heat, melt a knob of butter, then add chopped onions. Cook for 5–6 minutes until soft, golden, and fragrant.
Add the seasoning blend: salt, turmeric, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and cumin. Stir well to coat the onions and let the spices toast for 1–2 minutes to deepen the flavour and aroma.
Add your cooked basmati rice to the pan. Gently fold it in using a spatula, mixing thoroughly until every grain is coated and turn a bright yellow colour.
Turn off the heat, then add a generous handful of fresh chopped coriander (cilantro) and a squeeze of lime juice. Mix to finish the rice, vibrant, fluffy, and fragrant.
Lay the marinated chicken thighs evenly on a lined sheet pan. Oven bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20–23 minutes, or until golden, juicy, and slightly charred at the edges.

While the chicken rests make the sauce. In a blender cup add yogurt, mayo, chipotle paste, pineapple chunks, salt, garlic & onion powder and lime juice. Blend for 30–60 seconds until completely smooth and creamy.

Bottle up the sauce for the week (great for wraps, bowls). Slice the rested chicken into bite-sized cubes, then serve with the golden rice and a generous drizzle of the pineapple chipotle sauce.Your flavour- packed high protein meals are ready to ENJOY!
notes: Oven bake or air fry for 20-23 mins at 200C / 400F - you can broil at the end for 2-3 mins to get the top nicely crispy and charred

title: Honey Chilli Lime Chicken
description: This has to be one of the most flavorful easy chicken recipes i've made! Packed with nutrients, perfect for muscle gains and easy to make!

items: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Chilli Powder, Cumin, Paprika
50g (2oz) Habanero Hot Sauce (or hot sauce of choice)
210-220g (7.4-7.8oz) Uncooked Basmati Rice (yields approximately 560g or 20oz cooked)
200g (7oz) Avocado, thinly sliced (50g or 1.75oz per serving)

steps: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes. Place them in a bowl and add minced garlic, 1.5 servings chilli lime spice mix, drizzle of honey, freshly squeezed lime juice, and chopped coriander. Mix well until the color deepens and every cube is evenly coated.

For the chilli lime sauce, combine yoghurt, mayonnaise, your favorite hot sauce, honey, chilli powder, garlic powder, and a squeeze of lime juice in a blender. Blend until velvety and completely smooth!
(Optional) Bottle the sauce in batches and refrigerate for future meals.
Bring a pot of water to a boil and add the basmati rice. Simmer until the rice is fluffy and tender, then drain and set aside.

Meanwhile, slice the avocado into delicate pieces. Heat a pan over medium heat, melt some butter, and add the marinated chicken. Sauté for 6–8 minutes until the chicken turns golden brown with a slight char.
Once cooked, Lower the heat and add extra butter with a drizzle of honey. Stir for 1–2 minutes until the chicken is beautifully glazed. Repeat until all the chicken is cooked
Finally serve distribute the chicken evenly with a side of rice, avocado and top with the chilli lime sauce and ENJOY!
notes: Marinate the chicken for 10–15 minutes before cooking for better flavor.
Make the sauce in batches and store it in the fridge for the week.
Lower the heat before adding butter and honey. Stir until each piece is well coated.

title: Garlic Butter Chicken & Creamy Potatoes
description: One of the tastiest meal preps i've made! The chicken is bursting with flavour, perfectly complemented by the garlic and herb potatoes. So easy and simple, with amazing macros!

items: 2 Tsp Olive Oil (Optional) or Cooking Spray

steps: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes. In a bowl, season them with salt, parsley, chilli flakes, garlic & onion powder, paprika, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until the color deepens and all cubes are well coated.
Wash and dice the potatoes into small, even cubes. In another bowl, season them with the same spices and a light drizzle of olive oil. Toss until every piece is evenly coated.
Place the seasoned potatoes on a lined sheet pan (use baking paper) and bake or air fry at 200°C/400°F for 20–22 minutes until golden and crispy.
Meanwhile, heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt 10g of butter. Add half of the marinated chicken in a single layer Continue and cook for 3–4 minutes per side until a golden- brown crust forms.

Once cooked, lower the heat and add 5g extra butter, minced garlic, and parsley. Stir until each piece is evenly coated in the rich, garlic butter, then transfer to a plate. Repeat this process for the remaining chicken.

Back to the pan on low heat, add evaporated milk with garlic & herb cream cheese. Stir until the cheese melts and the sauce thickens slightly for about 5 minutes. Add the crispy potatoes in the sauce, gently mix until well combined and creamy
Finally serve and distribute into equal servings with the delicious chicken and your high protein meals are ready for the week, ENJOY!
notes: Cook chicken on medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown. Avoid overcrowding.
Lower heat before adding butter, garlic, and parsley. Stir for 1 minute to coat evenly.
Keep pan on low heat when adding milk and cream cheese.
Stir continuously for 5 minutes until slightly thickened, then add cooked potatoes.
Reheat in a pan on low for 4–5 minutes or microwave for 5 minutes.

title: Philly Cheese Steak Mac N Cheese
description: What an incredible combo! So cheesy & creamy, perfect for meal prep, great macros and so simple to make!

items: 20g (0.7oz) Grass Fed Butter (or any butter for cooking)
1.5 Tsp each Salt, Pepper, Paprika, Chilli Flakes
125g (1/2 Cup or 4.5oz) Pasta Water (after the pasta is cooked)

steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the macaroni and cook for 7–8 minutes until slightly underdone. Before draining, reserve 1 cup of pasta water (keep extra on hand if needed). Drain the pasta and set it aside.

While the pasta cooks, heat a pan over medium heat. Melt the butter, then add the minced garlic, chopped onion, and mixed bell peppers. Sauté for 5–6 minutes until the vegetables become soft and fragrant.

Push the vegetables to the edges of the pan to create a central well. Add the minced beef along with salt, pepper, paprika, and chilli flakes. Break the beef into small pieces with a spatula Continue and cook on high heat for 6–8 minutes until it is fully browned. Once browned, mix the beef with the vegetables.

Reduce the heat to low and add the cream cheese, shredded mozzarella, cheese slices, and the reserved pasta water. Stir continuously until the cheese melts and the sauce becomes smooth, creamy, and well combined with the beef and vegetables.

Lastly add the cooked macaroni into the sauce, mixing thoroughly to ensure everything is well coated. If needed, add extra pasta water to adjust the consistency. Finally, distribute the dish evenly into 4 servings, garnish with parsley, and ENJOY!
notes: Remove the veggies when cooking the beef or make a well in the center as instructed in Step 3.
Cook the beef thoroughly (add an extra 2–3 minutes if needed) before mixing in the cream cheese and mozzarella.
Lower the heat before adding any dairy ingredients to prevent curdling.

title: Creamy Honey Garlic Steak Noodles
description: An absolute incredible combo, perfect balance of savoury, sweet and spicy! Every bite is packed with flavour, great on the reheat too!

items: 80g (2.8oz) Gochujang Paste (adjust to your spice level)
125 (1/2 Cup) Noodle/ Pasta Water (From the boiled noodles)
Garnish Green Onion, Sesame Seeds, Parmesan Cheese

steps: Dice the beef into 1-inch cubes. Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until evenly coated, then set aside to marinate.
Bring a pot of water to a boil, then add raw noodles and cook for 4–5 minutes or according to packet instructions. Do not overcook.
Reserve 1 cup of noodle water, then drain and rinse noodles under cold water to stop cooking. Set aside.
Heat a pan on medium heat, melt butter, and sear the steak bites for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and charred.
Lower the heat, then add more butter, minced garlic, a drizzle of honey, and chopped parsley. Mix for 1 minute until the steak is coated and juicy. Set aside and repeat for remaining steak.
In the same pan on low heat, sauté minced garlic in the leftover butter for 2 minutes until fragrant. Add gochujang paste and stir for 1–2 minutes until combined.

Pour in milk, cream cheese, and grated parmesan. Stir continuously until melted and smooth, then add reserved noodle water and mix again. Let the sauce thicken for 1–2 minutes, then add the cooked noodles. Gently mix to coat well.
Serve the creamy gochujang noodles with the juicy steak bites. Garnish as desired and ENJOY!
notes: Cook/boil the noodles first as you'll need noodle water for the creamy sauce.
To reheat, simply place in a pot or pan on low heat for 5 mins. Add a little milk or water to the noodles to help liquify the sauce.

title: Creamy Garlic Cheesy Chicken & Potatoes
description: This might just be the best chicken recipe i've made! Creamy Garlic Parm Chicken with Cheesy Potatoes all in one pan perfect for weight loss!

items: 1/2 Tsp each Salt, Garlic Powder, Mixed Herbs
1 Tsp each Salt, Garlic Powder, Mixed Herbs, Paprika

steps: Cut the chicken breasts into cubes. In a bowl, combine with minced garlic, onion powder, mixed herbs, chilli flakes, paprika, salt, and olive oil. Mix well until evenly coated, then set aside.
Slice the potatoes into cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, garlic powder, mixed herbs, chilli flakes, paprika, and olive oil. Toss thoroughly to coat each piece.
Spread the seasoned potatoes onto a lined baking sheet (use baking paper). Oven bake or air fry at 200°C/400°F for 20–23 minutes until golden brown and crispy.

While the potatoes cook, heat a large pan over medium-high heat and melt the butter. Cook the chicken in batches, stirring occasionally, for 6–8 minutes until golden brown. Once all the chicken is cooked, lower the heat and return all the chicken to the pan.

With the heat on low, add milk, cream cheese, parmesan, salt, garlic, and mixed herbs to the pan. Stir continuously until it all melts into a smooth sauce, then let it simmer for 3–4 minutes until slightly thickened.
By now, the potatoes should be ready. Add them to the pan with the creamy chicken and mix thoroughly until creamy and well combined.
Sprinkle shredded mozzarella and fresh parsley over the dish. Cover with a lid and let it sit on low heat for 3–4 minutes until the cheese melts. Divide into 4 servings and ENJOY!
notes: Avoid burning or drying out the potatoes. Use cooking spray instead of olive oil if preferred.
After cooking the chicken, lower the heat before adding milk and cream cheese to prevent overheating.

title: Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice
description: There's no reason for you to be eating plain chicken and rice!

items: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Oregano, Thyme, Paprika, Chilli Powder

steps: Butterfly the chicken breasts into thinner halves. Season with 1.5 servings of Cajun spice mix and olive oil. Mix until both sides are fully coated, then let it marinate.
Cook the plain white rice for later. Bring a pot of water to a boil, add basmati rice, and cook for 8–10 minutes until fully cooked and fluffy. Drain and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium heat, melt butter, and cook the chicken fillets in batches for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and charred, then set aside.

Using the same pan with the flavorful butter left behind, keep the heat on medium and add chopped onion and garlic. Sauté for 5 minutes until fragrant, then stir in 1/2 serving of Cajun spice mix. Cook for 2–3 minutes until the spices are toasted and aromatic.
Add the cooked rice to the pan and mix thoroughly until every grain is coated and takes on the color of the spices. Stir in fresh parsley, then set aside.

For the creamy sauce, on low heat melt butter in a pan, then stir in 1/2 serving of Cajun spice mix. Toast for 1–2 minutes before adding milk, cream cheese, and parmesan. Stir over low heat for 4–5 minutes until smooth and slightly thickened.
Slice the cooked chicken into strips and serve over the spiced rice. Drizzle with the creamy sauce, garnish with fresh parsley, and enjoy your high- protein meals for the week!
notes: Marinate the chicken overnight for maximum flavor, ensuring each piece is well coated on both sides.
Cook on medium-high heat to develop a crispy crust, then let it rest before slicing.
Keep the heat low when making the sauce. Store separately and serve with the chicken and rice when ready to eat.

title: Garlic Butter Steak Bites
description: Truly one of the best combos, so much flavor and absolutely takes no time to make!

ingredientGroups.group: Garlic Butter Steak Bites – 800g (28oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef, 1 inch cubed

items: 15g (1 Tbsp) Sriracha or any Hot Sauce

steps: Cut the steaks into 1-inch cubes. Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, parsley, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until evenly coated, then set aside.

Dice the uncooked potatoes into small cubes and place them in a bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, parsley, and a drizzle of olive oil (optional). Mix well, then spread them on a lined baking sheet (use baking paper). Oven bake or air fry at 200°C/400°F for 20–22 minutes until crispy and golden.
While the potatoes cook, heat a pan over medium- high heat and melt 10g butter. Sear the half of the steak bites for 2–3 minutes per side until a rich, golden crust forms.

Lower the heat and add 10g extra butter, minced garlic, and chopped parsley. Stir for 1–2 minutes until the steak bites are fully coated in this garlic butter, then remove from heat. Repeat for the second batches.

Prepare the spicy mayo by mixing light mayo, sriracha, and lemon juice in a bowl. Serve the steak bites with the crispy potatoes, drizzle with the spicy mayo, and enjoy your high-protein meals for the week!
notes: Slice beef into 1-inch cubes to keep it juicy and develop a nice crust.
Air fry steak bites for 12–15 minutes at 200°C (400°F) as an alternative.
Use store-bought spicy mayo or make your own.
Reheat in an air fryer or oven for 5 minutes at 180°C (370°F), or in a pan on low heat for 4–5 minutes.

title: Crispy Garlic Chicken Fried Rice
description: There's no reason to eat bland meal preps! Taking chicken & rice to the next level! Incredibly simple & easy to make, packed with flavour and with great macros.

ingredientGroups.group: Crispy Garlic Chicken – 1000g (35oz) Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cubed – 2 Tsp Black Pepper – 1.5 Tsp Chilli Flakes – 2 Tsp Garlic Powder – 2 Tsp Onion Powder – 25g (1oz) Dark Soy Sauce – 25g (1oz) Light Soy Sauce – 2 Tsp Olive Oil (optional) – 20g (1oz) Reduced Fat Butter (for cooking) – 1 Tbsp Fresh Parsley, finely chopped Onion Butter Fried Rice
items: Extra Seasoning: 1 Tsp each Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Parsley
20g (1oz) Dark Soy Sauce (add more if needed)

ingredientGroups.group: Garlic Yum Yum Sauce (enough for 8+ meals)
items: Dash of Milk or Water for desired consistency

steps: Slice the boneless, skinless chicken thighs into bite-sized cubes. Season with black pepper, chilli flakes, garlic powder, onion powder, light and dark soy sauce, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until well coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate.

To make the Garlic Yum Yum sauce, combine light mayo, ketchup, sriracha, minced garlic, ginger powder, and rice vinegar in a bowl. Mix until completely smooth. Add a splash of milk or water to adjust the consistency if needed. Bottle and store in the fridge to use throughout the week.

Heat a pan over medium heat and melt a little butter. Cook the marinated chicken for about 5 minutes per side until golden, crispy, and cooked through. Add a handful of freshly chopped parsley, stir to coat the chicken well, then set aside to rest.
In the same pan, add a knob of butter and the chopped onion. Cook on medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, Continue stirring halfway through, until softened and caramelised.

Add chopped green onion (white part) and finely chopped carrots. Season with black pepper, onion powder, and parsley. Stir everything together until fragrant, then push the vegetables to one side of the pan.
In the empty side of the pan, pour in the beaten eggs. Stir continuously until scrambled and fully cooked, then mix in with the sautéed vegetables.

Add your leftover cooked rice to the pan, followed by soy sauce, oyster sauce, and chopped green onion (green part). Mix everything thoroughly until well combined and each grain of rice catches a deep colour. Add more soy sauce, if needed.
Serve the fried rice with the crispy chicken in 5 equal portions. Drizzle with Garlic Yum Yum sauce, garnish with sesame seeds, and ENJOY!

title: Honey BBQ Chicken & Garlic Parmesan Potatoes
description: The perfect balance of savoury, sweet & tangy! So much depth in flavour with even more protein thanks to the upgraded creamy sauce

items: 160g (5.6oz) Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Brand: G Hughes)

steps: Slice the chicken breasts into bite-sized cubes. Season with garlic powder, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, black pepper, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is well coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate while you prepare the potatoes

Slice the raw potatoes into small, even cubes and place them in a large mixing bowl. Season with salt, Italian herbs, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, grated parmesan, and olive oil. Mix well until all the potatoes are evenly coated. Spread them out in a single layer on a lined baking tray (use baking paper for easy cleanup). Oven bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20–22 minutes until golden and crispy.

Heat a pan over medium heat and melt some butter. Add the marinated chicken and cook for 5 minutes per side, or until seared and golden brown. Once cooked, lower the heat and stir in a drizzle of honey, BBQ sauce, and freshly chopped parsley. Mix everything together until the chicken is well coated and juicy. Set aside.

In a blender, combine cottage cheese and milk. Blend for 2 minutes until completely smooth. Pour the mixture into the same pan on low heat. Add Italian herbs, garlic powder, and grated parmesan. Stir gently as the sauce warms through and begins to thicken slightly. Do not boil the sauce - overheating will cause it to split.
Add the crispy roasted potatoes to the sauce. Stir gently to coat each piece in the creamy mixture. If the sauce is too thick, adjust with a splash of milk until you reach your desired consistency.
Serve the creamy potatoes with the BBQ chicken, dividing evenly into 5 portions. Your high-protein meal prep is ready to ENJOY!

title: Garlic Alfredo Steak & Mashed Potatoes
description: This is one of the most comforting meals i've ever made - The creamy sauce is not only packed with protein but also bursting with flavor. Potatoes are fluffy, super filling yet lower in calories, and the garlic- infused seared steak bites add the perfect savory touch.

items: 1000g (35oz) Raw Topside/ Top Sirloin Beef, 1 inch cubed
Pinch of Chilli Flakes (omit for no spice)
1/2 Tsp Chilli Flakes (omit for no spice)

steps: Slice the beef steaks into 1-inch cubes. Season generously with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, parsley, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until the steak bites are evenly coated, then set aside to marinate while you prep the potatoes.

Wash, peel, and chop the potatoes into thick, even chunks. Place them in a pot of cold water, bring to a boil, and cook for 12–14 minutes until just fork- tender. Drain the water, then cover the pot with a lid and let the potatoes steam for 5 minutes, this helps soften them further for a smooth mash.

Use a potato masher to mash the steamed potatoes gently until smooth and fluffy. Avoid over-mashing to keep the texture light. Add a knob of butter, cream cheese, milk, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix gently until fully combined and creamy.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add butter, and sear the marinated steak bites for 2–3 minutes on each side until golden brown and crusted. Lower the heat, then add more butter, minced garlic, chilli flakes, and chopped parsley. Toss the steak bites in the buttery glaze until coated and aromatic, then set aside

In a blender, combine cottage cheese and milk. Blend for 2 minutes until smooth. Back in the same pan over low heat, melt a small amount of butter. Add smoked paprika, chilli flakes, salt, mustard, plenty of minced garlic, and parsley. Sauté for 5 minutes until fragrant. Pour in the blended cottage cheese and stir until the Alfredo sauce becomes creamy and slightly thick. Remove from heat.
To serve, portion the creamy mash and steak bites into 5 meal prep containers. Drizzle generously with the homemade Alfredo sauce. Your flavour-packed highprotein meals are ready to ENJOY!

title: Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowls
description: One of the tastiest and most flavorful recipes I've made! Perfect for meal prep and weight loss.

ingredientGroups.group: Special Garlic White Sauce (big batch, store in bottle)
items: 25g (1oz) Pickle Juice (add to your desired consistency)

ingredientGroups.group: Fresh Crunchy Slaw (big batch, store separately)

steps: Place boneless, skinless chicken thighs into a large mixing bowl. Add minced garlic, your homemade shawarma spice mix, tomato paste, olive oil, and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is evenly coated and vibrant in colour. Set aside to marinate for at least 30 minutes-or longer for deeper flavour. Be patient-it's worth it!

For the garlic white sauce, combine yogurt, light mayo, honey, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and a splash of pickle juice for added tang. Mix until smooth and creamy, then bottle it up and store in the fridge. It'll keep well for multiple meals throughout the week.

Heat a pan on medium, melt a knob of butter, then sauté minced garlic and chopped onions for 5–6 minutes until softened and fragrant. Add turmeric, smoked paprika, and salt, then stir until the onions take on a deep yellow colour. Add washed basmati rice and toast for 2–3 minutes to build flavour. Pour in double the amount of water (e.g. 1 cup rice = 2 cups water),bring to a gentle bubble, stir once, Continue cover with a lid, and reduce to a low simmer for 10– 12 minutes. Check halfway and gently mix to avoid sticking and ensure even cooking.

Spread the marinated chicken thighs evenly on a lined sheet pan. Bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20–23 minutes until golden, slightly charred, and juicy. Once cooked, let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing into bite-size cubes.

To make the slaw, combine thinly sliced red onion, halved cherry tomatoes, chopped pickled gherkins, and fresh parsley in a bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, sumac, and a drizzle of olive oil. Toss until fully combined. For meal prep, store this slaw in a separate container to keep it crisp and fresh.

To serve, divide the golden turmeric rice into 5 meal prep containers with the juicy shawarma chicken, a portion of the fresh slaw, and finish with a generous drizzle of the garlic white sauce. Your high-protein shawarma bowls are prepped and ready to ENJOY!

title: Chicken Fajita Mac N Cheese
description: One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, packed with lots of flavour, easy to make with balanced macros.

ingredientGroups.group: Fajita Veggie Mix (Half for Chicken/Half for Mac)

steps: Slice boneless, skinless chicken breasts into bite- size cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, oregano, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin, and a drizzle of olive oil. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is evenly coated and takes on a deep reddish hue. Set aside to marinate for at least 20–30 minutes.

Bring a pot of water to a boil and cook the macaroni pasta for 8–10 minutes, or until al dente. Once cooked, reserve a little pasta water (optional), drain the rest, and set the pasta aside for later.

Heat a large pan over medium-high heat, melt a little butter, then add finely chopped onions and red, yellow, and green bell peppers. Cook for 5–6 minutes until softened and fragrant. Add a generous amount of fajita seasoning and minced garlic, and continue cooking for another 4-5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are golden and slightly caramelised. Transfer this fajita veggie mix to a bowl and set aside.

In the same pan, melt a bit more butter and cook the marinated chicken on medium heat for 5 minutes per side, Continue or until golden brown and seared. Lower the heat, then add a few spoonfuls of the fajita veggie mix, a drizzle of honey, and fresh chopped parsley. Toss the chicken until well coated in the sweet, savoury mixture. Set aside and repeat if cooking in batches.

To the same pan on medium-low heat, return the remaining fajita veggie mix. Pour in the blended cheese sauce (made from milk, cream cheese, and cottage cheese, blended until smooth). Stir continuously until the sauce is warm and velvety, then add low-fat cheddar cheese. Let it melt and thicken slightly, stirring as needed.

Add your cooked macaroni to the pan and gently fold it through the sauce until every piece is coated and the mac is ultra creamy. Let it simmer for a minute if needed to reach your preferred consistency.

Serve into 5 meal prep containers, topping each with the juicy fajita chicken. Garnish with fresh parsley or a sprinkle of cheese (optional), and your high- protein Chicken Fajita Mac N Cheese is ready to ENJOY all week long!

title: Orange Chicken Rice Bowls
description: There's absolutely no reason to be eating plain chicken & rice for weight loss! These taste ridiculously good and are ideal for meal prepping.

items: 1000g (35oz) Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cubed
Oven bake or air fry for 19-22 mins at 200C/400F. Should come out golden brownwith a glaze
250g (8.8oz) Uncooked White Rice/690g Cooked (leftover or day old cooked)
1 or 2 Tsp Red Pepper Flakes (omit for no spice)

steps: Slice the boneless, skinless chicken thighs into bite-size cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Season with black pepper, garlic and ginger paste, red pepper flakes, honey, sriracha, freshly squeezed orange juice, orange zest, and dark soy sauce. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is fully coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate for at least 30 minutes (or overnight for best flavour).

Heat a large pan on medium heat, melt a small amount of butter, then add sesame seeds. Toast for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally until golden and nutty. Add minced garlic and cook for another 2 minutes until fragrant. Season lightly with salt, then add leftover cooked rice and stir well. Cook for 2–3 minutes until fluffy, toasted, and aromatic. Garnish with chopped green onion and more sesame seeds, then set aside..

While the rice cooks, finely slice your vegetables: cucumber, red onion, carrots, cabbage, and green onion. Place in a large bowl and add rice vinegar, red pepper flakes, and a light drizzle of honey. Toss everything together until well combined. Store this crunchy slaw in a separate airtight container in the fridge - it stays crisp and tangy throughout the week.

Line a baking tray with baking paper, then evenly spread out the marinated chicken. Oven bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 19–22 minutes until golden brown and slightly charred on the edges. Let it rest for a few minutes before serving with all its juices.

Assemble your meal prep: divide the sesame garlic rice, orange-glazed chicken, and crunchy slaw into 5 meal prep containers. Keep the slaw separate if reheating. Your high-protein orange chicken bowls are ready to ENJOY all week!

title: Creamy Cajun Steak & Parmesan Potatoes
description: An absolutely phenomenal meal prep, incredibly delicious & easy to make! Every bite is bursting with flavor.

items: 1000g (35oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef, 1 inch cubed

steps: Slice the beef sirloin steaks into 1-inch cubes, then place them in a large mixing bowl. Season with salt, Italian herbs, chilli flakes, garlic powder, onion powder, parsley, smoked paprika, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until each piece is evenly coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate while you prep the veg.

Slice the washed, uncooked potatoes into small cubes. Place them on a large tray along with chopped red onion, broccoli florets, and red bell peppers. Season generously with Italian herbs, garlic powder, paprika, parsley, and grated parmesan. Use clean hands to toss everything thoroughly until all the vegetables are well coated. Add more seasoning if needed.

Transfer the seasoned vegetables onto a lined baking tray. Oven bake or air fry at 180°C (360°F) for 20–24 minutes, or until the potatoes and vegetables are tender, golden, and lightly crisped on the edges. Once done, set aside.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat, melt a little butter, then add the marinated steak bites in a single layer. Cook for 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown and seared. Avoid overcrowding the pan - work in batches if needed. Once cooked, lower the heat and add minced garlic and fresh parsley, stirring until the beef is coated in a garlicky glaze. Set aside to rest.

In the same pan over medium-low heat, melt a bit more butter and toast the extra seasonings for 1–2 minutes until aromatic. Then pour in milk, followed by cream cheese and grated parmesan. Stir continuously until the sauce becomes smooth, melted, and creamy.

Let the sauce simmer gently for 2–3 minutes until it thickens slightly. Then assemble your meals: divide the roasted parmesan potatoes and veggies evenly into 5 portions, top with the juicy steak bites, and drizzle with the creamy sauce. Garnish with extra parsley if desired, and your high-protein meal prep is ready to ENJOY all week!

title: Caramelized Onion Creamy Chicken
description: There's no reason to be meal prepping plain chicken & rice! This tastes absolutely incredible, so rich and creamy with great macros.

items: 350g (12.4oz) Red or White Onion, finely sliced

steps: Slice the chicken breasts into bite-sized cubes and transfer to a mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, oregano, smoked paprika, dried basil, and a drizzle of olive oil. Mix thoroughly until each piece is evenly coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate.

Heat a large pan over medium heat, melt down a little butter, then add the chicken in a single layer. Sear for 4–5 minutes per side until golden brown and slightly charred. Work in batches if needed. Once cooked, set aside to rest.

In the same pan, reduce heat to medium-low. Add more butter and toss in all the sliced onions. Cook slowly for 15 minutes or longer, stirring occasionally until deep golden and caramelised, this step builds flavour, so take your time. Meanwhile, boil and cook your white basmati rice in a separate pot for later use. Once onions are caramelised, season with salt, black pepper, paprika, and chilli flakes. Then add minced garlic and sun-dried tomatoes, cooking for an additional 2 minutes until fragrant.

Lower the heat fully and pour in milk, followed by cream cheese and grated parmesan. Stir gently and continuously until the mixture is smooth, creamy, and well combined. Now return the seared chicken to the pan along with a handful of freshly chopped parsley, giving everything a final stir until the chicken is coated in the creamy, savoury sauce.

For the rice, use a clean pan or the same one if large enough. On medium heat, melt a small amount of butter, then sauté minced garlic for 2 minutes until aromatic. Add salt to taste and a generous pinch of mixed or Italian herbs. Toast the herbs briefly for 30 seconds to release their oils, then add in the cooked rice.

Mix the rice well so the flavours fully combine. Remove from the heat, then grate over some fresh lemon zest and add a squeeze of lemon juice. Stir one last time until the rice is light, fragrant, and herby.
Evenly portion the lemon butter herb rice and creamy chicken into 5 meal prep containers. Garnish with more parsley if desired, and your high- protein meals are ready to ENJOY all week long!

title: Sweet & Sour Chicken Fried Rice
description: There's NO REASON to be eating plain chicken and rice to lose weight! Packed with flavour, better than takeout and ideal for meal prepping big batches.

items: Garnish Sesame Seeds & Red Pepper Flakes

steps: Slice boneless, skinless chicken thighs into bite- sized cubes and place them into a mixing bowl. Season with black pepper, onion powder, minced garlic, ketchup, pineapple juice, rice vinegar, and soy sauce. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is fully coated and vibrant in colour. Set aside to marinate while prepping the rest.

If you're not using leftover rice, start by boiling a pot of water. Add raw white rice and cook for 8–10 minutes until fluffy and fully cooked. Drain if needed and set aside to cool (cooling prevents clumping later). Meanwhile, dice your fresh pineapple (or drain canned pineapple), and chop red onion and red, yellow, and green bell peppers into small cubes.

Spread the marinated chicken evenly on a lined sheet pan, followed by the chopped pineapple and vegetables. Arrange in a single layer to ensure even cooking, don't overcrowd the tray. If needed, bake in batches. Note: Bell peppers and pineapple will release liquid during baking, so avoid overloading. Drizzle honey lightly across the top for extra glaze and sweetness.

Oven bake at 200°C (400°F) for 30 minutes until the chicken is golden and tender. If using an air fryer, cook at 200°C for 25–30 minutes. If the chicken hasn't browned to your liking, broil for an extra 3–5 minutes, keeping a close eye to avoid burning. The juices in the tray should reduce and create a sticky, caramelised glaze.

Heat a large pan over medium-high heat, melt some butter, then sauté chopped garlic, the white part of green onion, and diced carrots. Cook for 5–6 minutes until soft and fragrant. Push the veggies to one side of the pan.

On the empty side, pour in beaten eggs and stir continuously until fully scrambled. Mix the eggs together with the sautéed vegetables. Add in the leftover cooked rice, a splash of soy sauce, chopped kimchi, and kimchi juice. Finish with the green part of the green onion and stir everything together until well incorporated, fluffy, and full of colour.

Garnish with sesame seeds and red pepper flakes, then distribute the kimchi fried rice and sweet & sour chicken evenly into 5 meal prep containers. Your high-protein, flavour-packed meals are ready to ENJOY all week!

title: Chipotle Beef Potato Bowls
description: The flavours are absolutely phenomenal for how EASY this is to make! High volume low calories meals like this are a life saver for weight loss

items: 1.5 Tsp Chipotle Chilli Flakes (Omit for less heat)
250g (8.8oz) Low Fat Greek Yogurt (or yogurt of choice)

ingredientGroups.group: Tangy Pico De Gallo (enough for 6+ meals)

steps: Slice the potatoes into small cubes. Season with garlic powder, onion powder, regular or chipotle chilli flakes, parsley, smoked paprika, cumin, and a drizzle of olive oil. Use your hands to mix well until every piece is evenly coated.
Spread the seasoned potatoes on a lined sheet pan and oven bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20-23 minutes until golden and crispy. Once cooked, sprinkle salt to taste.

While the potatoes cook, prepare the creamy chipotle sauce. In a blender, combine low-fat yogurt, light mayo, chipotle paste, honey, lime juice, salt, garlic powder, and paprika. Blend until smooth, then bottle and refrigerate to use throughout the week.

Heat a pan over high heat, melt butter, and cook the ground beef for 6-8 minutes until browned and fully cooked. Lower the heat to medium, then add salt, garlic powder, onion powder, parsley, paprika, cumin, and chipotle paste. Mix thoroughly. If too dry, add a splash of water, then finish with a drizzle of honey and cook until juicy and golden. Remove from heat.

For the salsa, combine chopped tomatoes, red onion, red and green bell peppers, coriander, salt, pepper, and lime juice in a large bowl. Mix well and store separately to keep fresh and make reheating easier.
Serve into 5 even portions. Store in the fridge and reheat in a microwave or pan when ready to enjoy!

title: Harissa Chicken Rice Bowls
description: This is one of the best chicken recipes i've made! Such a simple marinade that requires very little effort for maximum flavour. Ideal for meal prep and weight loss and great for family gatherings

items: 160g (5.6oz) Harissa Paste or Red Pepper Paste

3 Tsp Olive Oil After blending the marinade, try to drain any excess liquid that builds to the surface. Allows for a thicker marinade with less moisture and chicken to get a good char/grill Oven bake or air fry for 20 mins at 200C and broil/grill for 5 mins or longer if needed to get that charred crust
Splash of Pickle Juice (for desired consistency)
300g (10.6oz) Fresh Tomatoes, de seeded & finely chopped

steps: In a blender or food processor, add roughly chopped tomatoes, a handful of parsley, garlic cloves, onion, red bell pepper, yogurt, harissa paste, salt, smoked paprika, oregano, cumin, and a drizzle of olive oil. Blend in short pulses for 5-8 seconds until slightly chunky - you want texture, not a completely smooth paste.
Add the marinade to the boneless chicken thighs and mix thoroughly with your hands until fully coated. Set aside to marinate while you prepare the rice.

Boil uncooked basmati rice in a pot for 8–10 minutes until fluffy. Meanwhile, heat a pan over medium heat, melt butter, and sauté chopped onions for 5 minutes until soft. Add salt, turmeric, parsley, paprika, and cumin. Toast for 2 minutes, then stir in the cooked rice until it turns golden and fluffy. Set aside.
Spread the marinated chicken evenly on a lined sheet pan. Oven bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20-25 minutes until golden and juicy. Broil for 2-3 minutes at the end if needed for extra char.

While the chicken cooks, make the creamy harissa sauce: blend low-fat yogurt, light mayo, harissa paste, and a splash of pickle juice until smooth. Bottle and refrigerate. For the salad, combine chopped tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, and parsley in a large bowl. Store separately to keep fresh and make reheating easier.
Once the chicken is done, let it rest for 2–3 minutes, then chop into bite-size pieces. Serve into 5 portions with the golden rice, salad, and creamy harissa sauce. Enjoy your high-protein meals!

title: Honey Butter Chicken Alfredo Pasta
description: One of the most indulgent meal preps i've made! The rich, sweet & savoury flavour of the chicken pairs beautifully with the light, fragrant creaminess of the pasta

items: 2 Pieces Parmesan Rind - Optional(outer layer, adds so much flavour!)

steps: Slice the chicken breasts into small cubes and place in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, chilli flakes, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and a drizzle of olive oil. Mix thoroughly with your hands until the colour deepens and the chicken is evenly coated. Set aside to marinate.
Bring a pot of water to a boil and add your pasta of choice - linguine works great. Cook for 8 minutes or until al dente. Drain the pasta and set it aside.

Heat a pan on medium heat and melt some butter. Cook the chicken cubes for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy. Once cooked, lower the heat and add a little more butter, a drizzle of honey, soy sauce, and fresh parsley. Mix everything well until the chicken is fully glazed and coated in the sauce. Set aside and repeat for the remaining chicken if needed.

In the same pan on medium-low heat, add lots of minced garlic and chopped sun-dried tomatoes. Cook for 3 minutes until soft and fragrant. Then add Italian herbs, salt, low-fat milk, light cream cheese, grated parmesan, and a couple of parmesan rind pieces (optional for depth of flavour). Keep stirring gently until the sauce is completely smooth and slightly thickened.
Add the cooked pasta along with more fresh parsley. Gently mix everything together until the sauce coats each strand and the pasta is creamy and indulgent.
Serve and distribute evenly into 5 meal prep containers with the honey butter chicken. Garnish if desired - your high-protein meals are ready to ENJOY!

title: Philly Cheesesteak Rice Bowls
description: This is genuinely one of the best combos with 67g Protein! Thinly sliced steak strips coated in a velvety protein cheese sauce paired with the most incredible garlic parmesan rice. Perfect for meal prep

items: 1000g (35oz) Raw Top Sirloin Beef, sliced into thin strips
260g (9oz) Uncooked Basmati Rice/ Approx 600g Cooked Rice

steps: Slice the beef steaks into extra thin strips and place in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, Worcestershire sauce, and olive oil. Mix well with your hands until evenly coated, then set aside to marinate.

Heat a pan over medium heat and melt some butter. Add sliced onions and mixed bell peppers, then cook for 5-7 minutes until softened and fragrant. Season with a pinch of salt and pepper, mix well, then set aside.

In the same pan, melt a little more butter on medium heat. Sauté minced garlic for 30 seconds, then add in your leftover cooked rice along with chilli flakes, plenty of grated parmesan, and freshly chopped parsley. Mix everything until fluffy, golden, and aromatic. Set aside once done.

Bring the heat up to medium-high, then add the marinated steak strips in a single layer. Sear for 4-6 minutes until browned and slightly charred. Once cooked, add the sautéed onions and peppers back in. Then add light cheese slices, a splash of milk, and low-fat cheddar cheese. Mix thoroughly until the cheese is melted, creamy, and well combined with the steak and veggies.
Serve and divide the garlic parmesan rice and Philly cheesy steak mix into 5 equal portions. Your high-protein meals are ready to ENJOY!

title: Crispy Nashville Hot Chicken Mac n Cheese
description: This is My Best Mac n Cheese recipe yet! An incredibly popular combo, tastes ridiculously delicious with way better macros and higher in protein. Simple cooking techniques, the chicken itself is 11/10!

items: Dry Spice Rub - Smoked Paprika, Garlic Powder, Onion Powder (once cooked)
1 Tsp Each: Smoked Paprika, Garlic & Onion Powder
1/2 Tsp each: Black Pepper, Chilli Powder

steps: Slice the boneless chicken thighs into cubes and place in a mixing bowl. Season with black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, chilli powder, baking powder, dark brown sugar, and a drizzle of olive oil. Mix thoroughly with your hands until well coated, then set aside to marinate.
Bring a pot of water to a boil, add the uncooked macaroni, and cook for 8 minutes until al dente. Drain and set aside for later.

Heat a pan on medium heat, melt some butter, then cook the marinated chicken for 5 minutes on each side (don't over crowd the pan) until golden brown with a crispy crust. Lower the heat, add a little more butter, a dry spice mix (smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder), and fresh parsley. Stir until the chicken is juicy and well coated, then set aside. Repeat for any remaining chicken.

Using the same pan on low heat, add low fat milk, light cream cheese, low fat cheddar, dijon mustard, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, chilli powder, and chopped parsley. Stir continuously until the sauce is smooth, melted, and creamy.

Add the cooked macaroni to the sauce and gently fold until evenly combined and creamy. Divide the mac and cheese with the crispy Nashville chicken into 5 portions - your high protein meals are ready to ENJOY!

title: Cajun Honey Butter Chicken & Creamy Potatoes
description: Taking one of my most popular recipes and making it even better! This tastes ridiculously good for how easy it is to make with those macros

items: Extra Seasoning: garlic, Onion Powder, Paprika, Oregano

steps: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes and place in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, oregano, chilli flakes, and a drizzle of olive oil. Mix well until fully coated and the colour deepens, then set aside to marinate.

Cut the uncooked potatoes into small cubes and place in a separate bowl. Season with garlic powder, Italian herbs, paprika, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly, then lay them flat on a lined sheet pan. Oven bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20-22 minutes until golden and crispy.

While the potatoes cook, heat a pan on medium, melt a little butter, and cook the seasoned chicken for 6-8 minutes until golden. Lower the heat, then add extra butter, this seasoning mix (garlic & onion powder, paprika, oregano), a drizzle of honey, and fresh parsley. Mix well until fully glazed and juicy, then set aside. Repeat if needed for remaining chicken.

In the same pan, add chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft. Stir in tomato paste and cook for another 2 minutes until fragrant. Lower the heat, then pour in evaporated milk and add garlic & herb cream cheese. Stir continuously until the sauce is smooth and slightly thickened.

Once the potatoes are cooked, fold them into the creamy sauce gently until fully coated and indulgent. Divide the creamy potatoes and honey butter chicken into 5 even portions - your high-protein meals are ready to ENJOY!

title: Street Corn Chicken Bowls
description: Tastes absolutely phenomenal, extremely easy to make with minimal ingredients. This is the best meal prep i've made in a while!

items: 1000g (35oz) Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes
50g (1.7oz) Cholula Hot Sauce, or hot sauce of choice
50g (1.7oz) Jalapeños, de seeded and finely chopped
Optional Squeeze of Lime, i didn't add it as the other components already have lime juice

steps: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, cumin, parsley, olive oil, and a good squeeze of lime juice. Toss until evenly coated and set aside to marinate while you prep the rice.

In a pot, add water using a 1:2 rice-to-water ratio. Add the washed uncooked rice, bring to a light boil, then reduce to a simmer for 10–12 minutes or until almost fully cooked. Once slightly underdone, remove from heat, drain any excess water, and cover with a lid to let the rice steam and ﬂuff up. Stir in a big handful of chopped fresh coriander and a pinch of salt. Mix gently to combine.

Heat a pan over medium heat and melt some butter. Add the marinated chicken and cook for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and seared. Lower the heat, then stir in extra butter, minced garlic, and chopped fresh parsley. Toss the chicken to coat it in the buttery, fragrant glaze.

In a large bowl, combine sweetcorn, light mayo, Greek yogurt, chopped and deseeded jalapeños, fresh coriander, Cholula hot sauce, Tajín, lime juice, and crumbled feta. Mix until creamy and well combined. Store in a separate container for best freshness.
Divide the chicken, coriander rice, and creamy corn salad into 5 equal portions. Your high-protein meals are now ready to fuel your week!
notes: Let the chicken marinate for at least 20 mins for better ﬂavour.
Cook chicken on medium heat for 6-8 mins till golden. Lower the heat when adding minced garlic and parsley.
Store the corn salsa in a separate container to make reheating easier.

title: Chilli Lime Chicken Potato Bowls
description: Incredibly delicious, vibrant ﬂavours, easy and simple with great macros. A game changer to meal prep for the week!

items: Marinate for as long as you can
Spread evenly on a lined sheet pan, make sure it ﬁlls the pan well
Oven bake or air fry for 20-22 mins at 200C / 400F
150g (5.3oz) Red & Green Bell Peppers, finely chopped

steps: Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs and place them in a large mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, lots of minced garlic, chilli flakes, smoked paprika, a drizzle of honey, lime zest and juice, and a splash of light soy sauce. Mix thoroughly with your hands until well coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate.

Slice the uncooked potatoes into small cubes and place on a lined sheet pan. Season with black pepper, smoked paprika, cumin, parsley, garlic powder, shredded coconut, and olive oil. Toss well until evenly coated, then spread out on the tray.Oven bake or air fry at 200°C / 400°F for 20–24 minutes until golden, crispy, and aromatic. Sprinkle with salt once cooked and set aside.
In a blender, combine Greek yogurt, light mayo, honey, 1 deseeded green chilli, a large handful of fresh coriander, Continue salt, and pepper. Blend until smooth, then bottle and refrigerate.

In a large bowl, add finely chopped cucumber (deseeded), red onion, ripe mango, red and green bell peppers, and fresh coriander. Mix until well combined. Optionally, sprinkle chilli flakes or Tajín seasoning. Store in a separate container and refrigerate.
Spread the marinated chicken thighs evenly on a lined sheet pan. Oven bake or air fry at 200°C / 400°F for 20–22 minutes until juicy and lightly charred.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing into cubes. Distribute the chicken, potatoes, sauce, and salad into 5 portions - and your high protein meals are ready for the week!
notes: Marinate for as long as you can.
Spread evenly on a lined sheet pan, make sure it fills the pan well.
Store the mango salsa in a separate container to make reheating easier.

title: Creamy Garlic Butter Steak Bites
description: Easily the best steak recipe i've made, the rice alone is incredibly flavorful. This meal prep is a game changer!

items: 1000g (35oz) Raw Top Sirloin Steaks, cut into 1 inch cubes
250g (8.8oz) Low Fat Milk or Light Evaporated Milk

steps: Slice the beef steaks into 1-inch cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, Italian herbs, garlic powder, paprika, and a drizzle of olive oil. Mix thoroughly with your hands until evenly coated, then set aside to marinate.

In a large pan over low heat, melt a little butter or spray lightly with oil. Add chopped sun-dried tomatoes and a sprinkle of Italian herbs. Sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant. Add the cooked white rice and mix well until everything is incorporated. Remove from heat, stir in plenty of grated parmesan and freshly chopped parsley, then fluff until rich, cheesy, and aromatic.

Heat a separate large pan over medium heat and melt a little butter. Add the marinated steak bites Continue and sear for 3–4 minutes on each side until browned and juicy. Reduce the heat, then add a bit more butter, minced garlic, and chopped parsley. Toss until the beef is coated in the garlicky butter glaze. Cook in batches if needed to avoid overcrowding.

Using the same pan on low heat, add low-fat milk, light cream cheese, paprika, and mixed herbs. Stir continuously until the cream cheese is fully melted and the sauce is smooth. Let it bubble gently to thicken to your desired consistency. Store separately for the best texture and taste when reheating.
Distribute the Tuscan-style rice and steak bites evenly into 5 meal prep containers. Your high-protein meals are now ready to enjoy throughout the week!

title: Korean BBQ Chicken Mac N Cheese
description: Two comfort food classics that taste absolutely indulgent and fit your goals

items: 1000g (35oz) Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed
1.5 Tsp Red Pepper Flakes or Chilli Flakes

steps: Trim excess fat from the boneless chicken thighs and place them in a large mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, red pepper flakes, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated, then set aside to marinate.
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add macaroni or your preferred pasta and cook for 8-10 minutes until al dente. Drain and set aside.

In a mixing bowl, combine thinly sliced cucumbers, red onion, green onion, red pepper flakes, garlic powder, sesame seeds, gochujang sauce, light soy sauce, and rice vinegar. Mix thoroughly, then store in a separate container and refrigerate.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt a little butter. Cook the marinated chicken thighs for 4-5 minutes on each side until golden and crispy. Remove from the pan and set aside.

In the same pan over low heat, add minced garlic, gochujang hot sauce, a drizzle of honey, and rice vinegar. Stir to form a rich, vibrant glaze. Add the chicken back to the pan and coat evenly until glossy and golden. Remove from heat and set aside.

In the same pan over medium-low heat, add milk, cream cheese, salt, black pepper, paprika, and a pinch of nutmeg. Stir until smooth, then add low- fat cheddar and mix until melted. Add the cooked macaroni and stir until fully coated and creamy.
Slice the glazed Korean chicken into bite-sized cubes. Distribute evenly across 5 servings along with the mac & cheese and cucumber gochujang salad. Your high-protein meals are ready to ENJOY!

title: Korean BBQ Beef Bowls
description: Tastes absolutely incredible for how easy this is to make, packed with 56g of protein!
steps: In a bowl, combine light and dark soy sauce, garlic and ginger paste, gochujang, honey, oyster sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame seeds. Mix until fully combined, then set aside.

Heat a pan on medium, melt some butter, and cook chopped onions for 5 minutes until soft. Increase heat to high, add lean ground beef, and cook for 8 minutes until browned, using a spatula to break it up.
Lower the heat to medium, pour in the prepared sauce, and cook for 4-5 minutes until the beef turns golden and slightly caramelised. Finish with chopped green onion and sesame seeds, then set aside.
For the Korean spicy sauce, mix low-fat yogurt, gochujang, and honey in a bowl. Add a splash of milk to loosen the consistency if needed. Bottle and store for future use.

In a large bowl, combine thinly sliced cucumber, grated carrots, red onion, green onion, light soy sauce, sriracha, rice vinegar, and garlic powder. Toss gently until evenly coated. Store separately to keep fresh and make reheating easier.
Serve and divide the Korean beef, white rice, crunchy slaw, and spicy sauce into 5 portions. Your high-protein Korean-style meals are ready to ENJOY!

title: Honey Chilli Crisp Chicken Bowl
description: Every bite is bursting with flavor - Savoury, sweet and a lil spice. Crispy, juicy chicken, seasoned rice, and a bright pineapple avo salsa that cuts through with freshness. A combo that's seriously next level

items: 30-40g (1.4oz) Chilli Crisp Oil drain the extra oil (Brand: Lee Kum Kee)

steps: Trim any excess fat from the boneless chicken thighs and place them in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, paprika, chilli crisp, and a drizzle of honey. Mix well with your hands until the colour deepens and the chicken is fully coated. Set aside to marinate.

In a large bowl, combine diced pineapple (fresh or canned), cucumber, red onion, red bell pepper, avocado, and plenty of chopped coriander. Season with salt, black pepper, and a squeeze of fresh lime juice. Mix gently until well combined. Transfer to a separate container and refrigerate to keep it fresh and crisp for the week.

Add washed uncooked basmati rice to a pot of water (use your preferred rice-towater ratio). Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer for 8-10 minutes or until the rice is cooked through and fluffy. Once cooked, stir in freshly chopped coriander, dried oregano, and a few cracks of chilli garlic salt. Mix gently and set aside.
Spread the marinated chicken thighs evenly on a lined sheet pan. Oven bake or air fry at 190°C / 385°F for 16-18 minutes until golden brown and juicy.

Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes, then slice into juicy cubes. Toss the pieces back onto the tray to soak up all those resting juices. Serve with the herby seasoned rice and the vibrant pineapple avocado salsa. Enjoy your flavour packed, high protein meals!
notes: Spread evenly on a lined sheet pan, oven bake or air fry for 16-18 mins at 190C/ 385F until golden brown and juicy
Once cooked, rest for 5 mins then slice into delicious cubes and mix in all the resting juices
Mix thoroughly till well combined then store in separate containers and refrigerate. Makes reheating the chicken and rice easier and keeps salsa fresh

title: Turkish Garlic Beef Pasta
description: Incredibly delicious for how easy it is to make with over 60g of Protein! A popular dish also known as Yalanci Manti. Juicy ground beef serve with pasta of choice topped with mint garlic sauce and chilli butter

items: Avocado Oil Cooking Spray (or any of choice)
Add extra tomato paste if needed
260g (9.1oz) Uncooked Pasta of choice Garlic Mint Sauce
Pasta Water for extra volume Garnish

steps: In a large bowl, combine a generous amount of thick yogurt (I used Skyr for its high protein content), minced garlic, dried or fresh mint, a pinch of salt, and a good squeeze of lemon juice. Stir until smooth and creamy. Transfer to a separate container and refrigerate to keep it fresh for the week.

Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add your pasta of choice (I used a mix of conchiglie and fusilli) and cook for about 8 minutes or until al dente. Reserve some of the pasta water, drain the rest, and set the pasta aside.

Heat a pan over medium heat and add avocado oil spray. Sauté chopped onions for 8–10 minutes until soft and golden brown. Then add salt, black pepper, paprika, cumin, minced garlic, and tomato paste. Cook for another 3-4 minutes until fragrant and well combined.

Increase the heat to high, add the lean ground beef to the pan, and use a spatula to break it up. Cook for about 8 minutes until browned and fully cooked through. Season again to taste with salt, pepper, and spices. Mix well until juicy and flavourful, then set aside.

In a small pan over low heat, melt a little light butter. Add paprika, chilli flakes, tomato paste, a pinch of salt, and a splash of the reserved pasta water. Stir until smooth and let it simmer gently until rich and glossy.

Divide the pasta and juicy beef into 5 equal portions. Top each with a few spoonfuls of the garlic mint yogurt and a drizzle of the chilli butter sauce. Garnish with chopped cherry tomatoes, fresh mint and chilli garlic seasoning. Your delicious high protein meals are ready to ENJOY!
notes: Pan on medium heat, cooking spray, cook chopped onion 8-10mins till golden and soft. Add initial seasoning mix with garlic and tomato paste. Cook for 3-4 mins till fragrant
Add lean ground beef, increase heat to high. Use spatula to break up the meat, cooking spray 8 mins or till fully brown. Add extra seasoning to taste
Once pasta is cooked, reserve some pasta water to use for later
Make this sauce ahead if time, store separately to keep fresh and unspoiled

title: Chicken Fajita Mac n Cheese
description: So indulgent, high in protein, cheesy and literally tastes like you're eating a cheat meal but you're not!

items: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Oregano, Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Paprika, Chilli Powder, Cumin
240g (8.5oz) Uncooked Macaroni Pasta (or pasta of choice)

steps: First slice your chicken breasts into cubes, then add 1.5 serving fajita spice mix with olive oil and lime juice. Mix till you lose patience then set the chicken aside to marinate!

Now cook your pasta. Fill a pot with water, bring to a boil then add the macaroni pasta and boil for 8 mins till aldente then drain and set aside. While the pasta is cooking get a pan on medium heat, melt down butter then cook the chicken for 3-4 mins each side till golden brown then set aside. Repeat till all the chicken is cooked

In the same pan in the remaining butter on medium heat add your chopped onions Continue and bell peppers with 1/2 serving fajita spice mix Give it a good mix in then cook for 5 mins till soft and fragrant
Then lower the heat completely and add the milk, cream cheese, grated cheddar and shredded mozzarella. Mix till the cheese melts and the sauce is cheesy and creamy

Now add the cooked macaroni in the creamy sauce, give it a good mix till well incorporated, add the cooked chicken with a squeeze of lime juice. Give it one final mix then distribute evenly into 4 servings and your high protein measl are ready to ENJOY!
notes: Cook onions and peppers on medium heat for at least 5 minutes until soft and fragrant.
Keep heat on low when adding milk and cream cheese to prevent the sauce from splitting.
Reheat in a microwave or pan on low heat for 5 minutes. Add a splash of milk to loosen and restore creaminess.

title: Chicken Shawarma Loaded Fries
description: This combo is truly INCREDIBLE! Chicken is so flavorful, served on top of seasoned fries and topped with pickled onions and a delicious white sauce!

items: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Cumin, Turmeric, Paprika
100g (3.5oz) Low Fat Sour Cream or Yogurt
900g (32oz) Raw Potatoes, thinly sliced into fries
1 Tsp each Salt, Black Pepper, Paprika, Cumin

steps: Slice the chicken breasts into thin strips and place them in a bowl. Add olive oil, minced garlic, 1.5 servings of shawarma spice mix, and a squeeze of lemon juice. Mix thoroughly until well coated, if the color isn't vibrant, add more seasoning. Let marinate while prepping the fries.

Slice the potatoes into thin fries and season with salt, pepper, paprika, cumin, and olive oil. Toss until evenly coated, then spread on a lined baking tray (use baking paper). Bake or air fry at 200°C/400°F for 20 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crispy.

Place the marinated chicken on a separate lined baking tray. Bake or air fry at 200°C/400°F for 15 minutes, until golden brown with slightly charred edges. If possible, cook the chicken and fries at the same time to save time, or cook separately if needed.

While the chicken and fries cook, prepare the white sauce. In a bowl, whisk together sour cream, mayo, minced garlic, black pepper, and a squeeze of lemon juice until smooth. Transfer to a bottle and refrigerate for meal prep use.
To assemble, layer the shawarma-spiced chicken over the crispy fries. Top with pickled red onions, crumbled feta cheese, and a generous drizzle of white sauce. Serve and ENJOY!
notes: Pan-fry the chicken in light butter or air fry, both methods offer great results.
Make the white sauce in bulk and store it in the fridge for other meals.
Serve the white sauce, pickled onions, and feta cheese fresh when ready to eat.

title: Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowls
description: This might just be the best chicken & rice recipe i've made, juicy shawarma chicken paired with golden fluffy rice, my delicious spicy samurai sauce and yogurt cucumber mix.

items: Season to taste: Salt, Garlic Powder, Cumin
30g (1.1oz) Buffalo Hot Sauce (or any hot sauce)
1/2 Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Paprika

steps: Butterfly slice the chicken breasts into thinner fillet halves. Season both sides with salt, black pepper, onion powder, parsley, smoked paprika, cumin, minced garlic, and lemon juice. Rub the spices in thoroughly, ensuring even coverage, then set aside to marinate.

For the golden rice, heat a pot over medium heat and melt butter. Add the spice blend (turmeric, paprika, salt, cumin) and toast for 1–2 minutes until fragrant. Stir in the washed basmati rice, mixing until each grain is coated in the spices. Pour in 400g water (double the rice weight), bring to a light boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover and simmer for 7–8 minutes until fully cooked and fluffy. Drain any excess water and set aside.

While the rice cooks, prepare the samurai sauce and cucumber salad. Continue • Samurai Sauce: In a bowl, whisk together yogurt, mayo, hot sauce, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika until smooth. Store in a squeeze bottle for easy use. • Cucumber Salad: In another bowl, combine yogurt, chopped cucumbers, tomatoes, and fresh parsley. Season with salt, garlic powder, and cumin to taste. Mix well and store separately for easier reheating.

Heat a pan over medium heat and melt butter. Cook the chicken fillets for 3–4 minutes per side, ensuring a golden-brown crust without burning the spices. Set aside to rest and repeat until all chicken is cooked.
Once everything is ready, slice the chicken into bite- sized cubes. Serve with golden rice, cucumber salad, and a generous drizzle of samurai sauce. Garnish with fresh parsley and ENJOY!
notes: Cook chicken over medium heat to prevent spices burning and develop a golden brown crust.
Prepare the samurai sauce and cucumber salad in bulk and store separately. Serve fresh when ready to eat.
Reheat chicken and rice in a pan on low heat, covered, for 5 minutes.

title: Honey Buffalo Chicken Rice Bowls
description: An incredible combo, packed with flavour and perfect for weight loss.

items: 1/2 Tsp each: Garlic Powder, Smoked Paprika, Black Pepper
200g Uncooked Basmati Rice/Approx 135g Cooked Rice per serving

steps: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes and place them in a bowl. Add minced garlic, black pepper, onion powder, paprika, salt, and olive oil. Toss until evenly coated, then set aside to marinate.

Prepare the honey buffalo sauce by blending mayo, buffalo hot sauce, honey, lemon juice, garlic powder, paprika, and black pepper until smooth and creamy.
